coverage.summary: Applies to any tenancy statewide and binds lessors and agents of the lessor, except vacation or recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.
coverage.other_conditions: Excludes any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less that is for a vacation or recreational purpose (subsection 9).

result.notes: I removed the sentence 'Broker fees are governed separately by G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD½' from other_conditions. It describes a different statute and how fees are paid, not which buildings, units or owners this rule covers. I also tightened the summary to the statutory wording ('any tenancy'; 'lessor or agent of the lessor'). All other coverage fields stay null. D052 has no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or local-preemption conditions for this section.
